content_of_post_to_comment: I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again, the world is already drowning in "content." We don't need more of it. We need more art. We need more emotion. We need more statues and gargoyles atop grand and beautiful buildings. We need a haunted forest and stories that inspire us to see through the darkness. We need more mystery, creativity, and authenticity. We need more life.
